description: Head/neck pitch angle in degrees (head tilt up/down)
derivation_or_formula: arctan(-a_x / sqrt(a_y^2 + a_z^2)) * (180/pi) or complementary filter with gyro_y
justification: Key biomechanical feature separating feeding head down (-60 deg) from resting/standing.

description: Head/neck roll angle in degrees (lateral tilt)
derivation_or_formula: arctan(a_y / a_z) * (180/pi) or complementary filter with gyro_x
justification: Captures lateral head tilting, grooming, licking, and posture.

description: Head yaw angle in degrees (compass heading)
derivation_or_formula: Absolute yaw cannot be maintained without magnetic reference (gyro drifts rapidly)
justification: Absolute spatial heading requires a magnetometer or stationary beacons not present on CattleCare.

derivation_or_formula: sqrt(a_x^2 + a_y^2 + a_z^2)
justification: Primary metric for overall kinetic activity level, movement intensity, and dynamic body acceleration.

derivation_or_formula: Angular delta from baseline posture
justification: Useful for detecting dynamic head turning and scanning behavior.
